items.title: Your Voice Agent is Just a Walkie Talkie — Neil Zeghidour, Gradium
items.content_snippet: On a phone call with someone close to you, as much as 20 percent of the time you are both talking at once. Every real time voice model shipping today is half duplex: it is either listening or speaking, never both. That gap is the whole argument of this talk. items.title: Voice Agents Can Just Do Things — Charlie Guo, OpenAI
items.content_snippet: The Moviefone hotline was a speech to speech system. The GPS unit in your parents' car was an event to speech system. Charlie Guo works on developer experience at OpenAI, and he opens by pointing out that the three modes of voice interaction are all decades old, which makes the question not what is newly possible but what we stopped noticing.
